reply_text:
I replied to Linnea in her DM (DV04TRA0002): "Got it, Linnea. I'll remember that Oriel Tolland is your go-to escalation contact at Dreyness Brewing Co. for the Plover rollout from now on. I'll keep it to our DMs and won't bring it up with anyone else."

I didn't save a separate note. gbrain already records her direct messages as facts that only she can see, so this one is stored automatically. If I'd written it with gbrain's `remember` tool, it would probably have been readable by others too, since I couldn't tell who sees those notes by default. That would break the rule that what someone tells me in a DM stays with them.
